# DSH Matt Pocock Skills
> Matt Pocock's engineering and productivity skills, adapted for DeepSeek Harness as a Cordis bundle
ocock's engineering and productivity skills, adapted for DeepSeek Harness as a Cordis bundle plugin.
English | 中文
## What's Included
This plugin provides the skills from Matt Pocock's repository that **do not overlap** with DSH built
-in skills. The following are already built into DSH and are therefore **not** duplicated here:
| DSH Built-in | Matt's Equivalent |

| `tdd` | `tdd` |
| `grilling` | `grilling` |
| `diagnosing-bugs` | `diagnosing-bugs` |
| `code-revi

ew` | `code-review` |
| `prototype` | `prototype` |
| `research` | `research` |
| `wizard` | `wizard

` |
| `writing-for-agents` | `writing-for-agents` |
| `domain-modeling` | `domain-modeling` |
| `cod
ebase-design` | `codebase-design` |
### Skills Provided by This Plugin
#### Engineering (user-invoked)
| Skill | Description |
| `ask-matt` | Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the user-invoked skills. |
| `grill-with-docs` | Grilling session that also builds your project's domain model, sharpening ter

minology and updating `GLOSSARY.md` and ADRs inline. |
| `triage` | Move issues through a state mach

ine of triage roles. |
| `improve-codebase-architecture` | Scan a codebase for deepening opportuniti

es, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick. |
| `setup-matt
-pocock-skills` | Configure this repo for the engineering skills (issue tracker, triage labels, doma

in doc layout). Run once per repo. |
| `to-spec` | Turn the current conversation into a spec and pub

lish it to the issue tracker. |
| `to-tickets` | Break any plan, spec, or conversation into a set of

tracer-bullet tickets. |
| `implement` | Build the work described by a spec or set of tickets, driv

ing TDD at pre-agreed seams. |
| `implement-spec` | Implement a whole spec on one integration branch

using concurrent subagents. |
| `wayfinder` | Plan a huge chunk of work as a shared map of decision

tickets, then resolve them one at a time. |
| `retro` | Suggest improvements to the coding agent's

environment after a session. |
| `pr` | The shape a pull request body should take. |
#### Productivity (user-invoked)
| Skill | Description |

| `grill-me` | Get relentlessly interviewed about a plan or design. |
| `handoff` | Compact the curr

ent conversation into a handoff document. |
| `teach` | Teach the user a new skill or concept over m

ultiple sessions. |
| `to-questionnaire` | Turn a decision into a Markdown questionnaire for the per

son who can answer it. |
| `wait-what` | Re-pitch a message with the context you're missing. |
## Installation
### Option 1: Install as a DSH Cordis Bundle (recommended)
1. Clone this repository:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

2. In your DSH session, ask the agent to install the bundle:
> "Please install the bundle at `/path/
to/dsh-matt-pocock-skills` using plugin_manager"
3. After installation, the skills appear in your session skill catalog.
### Option 2: Copy to `~/.dsh/skills/` (simple, no plugin)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
DSH's filesystem skill provider automatically discovers skills under `~/.dsh/skills/`.
## Usage
Once installed, skills are available via the DSH skill system:
- **User-invoked skills**: mention the skill name in conversation (e.g., "use ask-matt", "run grill-

with-docs")
- **Model-invoked skills**: the agent automatically selects them when the task matches
## Adaptation Notes
The original skills were written for Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI. This DSH adaptation:

- Replaces `sub-agent` references with DSH's `subagent` tool
- Replaces Claude Code-specific tool ca

lls with DSH equivalents
- Adds DSH-compatible YAML frontmatter (`whenToUse`, `user-invocable`, `dis

able-model-invocation`)
- Skips skills already built into DSH to avoid duplicates
